_comment: Investigated causes of differences between the automated BOM and the manual NMK reference. Keys: '<part or label>' | '<part>|<network>' | '<part>|<network>|<G|NG>'. Text only - never used to change quantities.
Total Route Mileage: Reference row 6 is typed-in. Network totals for NMK-R02 (14.965 mi), R03 (18.96) and R05 (24.80) equal the sum of route-footage labels (79,017 / 100,133 / 130,955 ft) within rounding. Grant/Non-Grant split differs: the reference split cannot be reproduced from the Non-Grant polygons now in the drawing.
Total Route Mileage|NMK-R04: Reference 16.54 mi (87,331 ft). Drawing: R04 trench 84,529 ft + transport-corridor trench/strand now booked to R04. Transport corridor treatment differs from the reference.
Aerial Footage|NMK-R04: Reference 5,740 ft. Drawing aerial-strand labels in the OTN transport corridor total 5,279 ft (all booked to R04). 461 ft unexplained (risers are 4 x 25 ft = 100 ft).
UG Footage: CalcFTG.lsp sums CX1-FTG-N2 FTG labels (layers RTE_UGTRENCH / GRANT FTG / NON-GRANT FTG) inside a selected closed boundary, using a window polygon (whole label inside). The tool does the same with the OLM boundary and the Non-Grant polygons. The delivered drawings have no GRANT FTG / NON-GRANT FTG layers, so the reference split was made by re-layering labels during BOM prep and was not saved. Reference rows 9/10 for R04/R05 used cable sums instead.
Total Drop Footage: FX_DROPS drop lines: NMK-R03 Non-Grant 52,752 vs reference 52,678 (0.14%). Reference row = 'total - grant' (Non-Grant only). R02/R04 have no drop lines in the combined drawing (FXAUTO not run / not saved), so they are blank and flagged. R05 differs by the same Non-Grant boundary shift seen on every R05 line.
FE0-MAX10EXP4: MAX peds stock 4 ports (template note 'M Peds Stock 4 upgrade to 8'). No MAX ped in NMK or DMI feeds more than 2 passings (CX1-COUNT/CX1-COMCNT), so no upgrade is needed. Reference = every MAX10 in R03 Grant and R04 Grant only; the new template defaults I23..K23 = MAX10 count. Both are a blanket policy, not a calculated need - confirm with the SME which applies.
FE0-07264810: Template note asks for a hand count of grounds (splices ending in G, first in line, ending in 0, EOL peds). Reference left it blank. Audit shows splice points ending in G only.
FM0-FF11002: SME: burns & heat shrink are not updated in the BOM. Audit shows fusion-splice count only.
FE0-R863927: SME rule with pooled packages: R03 1, R04 1, R05 3 trays -> 2 packages (exact network totals). R05 cell split differs only because NMK-05131 is 23 ft from a Non-Grant edge.
FE0-R579575: SME rule: trays per location ROUNDUP(splices/48), 2-tray packages pooled per column. R02 7 trays -> 4, R04 7 -> 4, R05 9 -> 5 (all exact). R03: 03001G 255 -> 6 + 03004 100 -> 3 = 9 trays -> 5 vs reference 4; the reference appears to have counted 03004 as <= 96 splices.
CBP-MAX10DSM24|NMK-R03: Network total matches (51). One MAX10 is classified Grant by the current Non-Grant polygons but Non-Grant in the reference - ped near a polygon edge.
CBP-MAX5DSM24: Network totals match exactly in all four networks. Grant/Non-Grant split differs by 2-3 peds in R02-R04 and 8 in R05: peds near Non-Grant polygon edges; R05 also shows larger Non-Grant extents in the reference (vault, 450B, cable and route all shift the same way), suggesting the R05 Non-Grant boundary was edited after the manual BOM.
CBV-HGIB2436|NMK-R05: Network total matches (9). Reference books one vault as Non-Grant; it lies inside Grant per current polygons (same R05 boundary pattern).
FE0-FOSC450B66NT0B3V|NMK-R05: Network total matches (3). Reference books one 450B as Non-Grant; NMK-05131 sits 23 ft from a Non-Grant polygon edge.
FFA-F902402G5B|NMK-R04: Drawing cable labels AND splice reports both give FC024 = 34,586 ft (+100 ft OLM tail). The reference moves 5,187 ft from FC024 to FC048 (FC024+FC048 total agrees exactly) - likely a manual BOM error; please confirm.
FFA-F904804M6B|NMK-R04: See FC024 NMK-R04: reference FC048 is 5,187 ft higher than the drawing labels and splice reports.
FFA-F902402G5B|NMK-R05: +100 ft = OLM -> NMK-05001G FC024 tail present in the splice reports but not labelled in the drawing. Reference counted this tail for R02 and R03 but not for R04/R05 (inconsistent). Tool includes it everywhere.
FFA-F902402G5B: Network totals = sum of cable-label TOTAL (route + slack) + 100 ft OLM tail from splice reports. Grant/Non-Grant split follows routed spans; reference split differs by a few spans near boundaries.
FFA-F909608E7B: Network totals match. Split: reference puts 1,872 ft of R02 FC096 in Non-Grant; routed spans give 1,009 ft - spans near the boundary.
FM0-3FE47548AD: SME: SFP = ROUNDUP(Jumper Calculator 'Splitters Required' / 2) per column, regardless of the splitter actually designed.
